item.title: CT Senator Demands Vote On War Powers Resolution Following Iran Strikes
item.description: Enacted in 1973, a war powers resolution, also known as a war powers act, requires Congressional authorization or an emergency created by an attack on the United States, its territories or armed forces before a president can send troops into action abroad. It also limits military action to 60 days without Congressional approval or a declaration of war.
